_about: Who each investor is and the names they file under. Never what they hold: holdings come only from exchange shareholding filings (data/filings/shareholding.json). Patterns are regular expressions matched from the start of a normalised holder name (upper case, punctuation stripped, & as AND, PVT as PRIVATE, LTD as LIMITED). An investor whose patterns match nothing is left out of the output.
